owner_mandate: QF SOLVER 0.3.0 — JALON J23, section 3; permits bounded external FEM and artifacts, but not publication, release, tag, or merge.
objective: Compare archived QF TET10 transient flexure on its exact 8x4x4 mesh with an independently assembled Abaqus/Standard C3D10 linear-solid model, using the same nodal load history, constraints, material, time grid, and physical probe nodes.

mesh.type: same archived straight-sided TET10 mesh / Abaqus C3D10
mesh.abaqus_node_labels: archived zero-based node indices plus one; local edges 1-2, 2-3, 3-1, 1-4, 2-4, 3-4 checked by midpoint coordinates

model.boundary_conditions: UX=UY=UZ=0 on every node at x=0; all other solid translations free; no solid rotational DOFs.

load.physical_description: uniform +UZ traction on x=L over 0.01 m^2
load.independent_load_preflight: reintegrate constant traction over 32 quadratic surface triangles; for each T6 triangle, exact resultant weights are zero at corners and area/3 at each midside node
load.abaqus_application: CLOAD with the archived QF equivalent nodal vector, scaled by the same tabular amplitude; this deliberately removes solver-specific surface-load integration from the response comparison

time_integration.method: Abaqus/Standard direct integration with ALPHA=0, BETA=0.25, GAMMA=0.5; intended to match Newmark average acceleration
time_integration.field_output: 800 equal time intervals with exact time marks, plus initial state if provided by the ODB

reference_and_comparison.independent_solid_reference: Abaqus/Standard C3D10 is prepared but no local executable is usable; no Abaqus answer is available yet.
reference_and_comparison.existing_mechanical_reference: J12/J13 continuous Euler-Bernoulli cantilever modal series with 64 modes and a transverse tip-force history; 32/64 truncation difference was checked at <=1e-5 of the 64-mode peak on the J13 grids.
reference_and_comparison.existing_reference_limits: Euler-Bernoulli omits transverse shear, rotary inertia, the three-dimensional clamp boundary layer, and the solid section discretization. It is not an exact solution to the 3D model.
comparison_metrics: absolute displacement history differences at identical physical probe positions and QF times
RMS and maximum absolute displacement differences normalized to the QF absolute peak at that probe over the common time interval
absolute peak magnitude and physical time of peak
support resultant force and moment at archived 0.8 ms QF equilibrium checkpoints; one exactly duplicate 80 ms checkpoint is collapsed only after equality verification
reference_and_comparison.acceptance_thresholds: none; comparisons are descriptive. No correlation PASS or dynamic qualification is defined by this contract.

external_tool.version_probe_result: exit code 1; wrapper refers to missing abq2019.bat
external_tool.other_solver_commands: CalculiX ccx and Code_Aster as_run were not found
external_tool.version_to_record_if_run: exact Abaqus/Standard release and build; data-check the generated keyword deck before the single solve
external_tool.documentation_version_caveat: Current official Abaqus documentation was consulted; local wrapper suggested 2019 but was unusable, so keyword compatibility remains to be confirmed by a real data check.

execution_plan_if_external_runtime_becom.retry_policy: stop after any data-check error, solver error, interruption, or unexpected output schema; another attempt requires a classified new hypothesis, new contract, and preserved prior artifacts
execution_plan_if_external_runtime_becom.budget_semantics: RSS and storage are observed soft limits unless the external host provides real OS quotas; preserve logs and partial ODB on stop.
execution_plan_if_external_runtime_becom.not_run_reason: No usable Abaqus, CalculiX, or Code_Aster executable was found. The repository's current registered monitored-FEM scopes do not include this J23 QF FEM node; no direct QF solve was attempted.

artifacts_to_preserve: generated input deck and its SHA-256
exact input archive hashes and this frozen contract
Abaqus version banner and data-check output
comparison metrics JSON, curve figure, and script versions
partial outputs and failure status if the single attempt stops
historical_statuses_unchanged: all J14-J22 harmonic residual guard and verifier statuses
